title: Workers KV experiencing elevated error rates in Western Europe Region

updates.body: We are investigating an issue affecting Workers KV in the Western Europe Region, which may result in elevated error rates for read requests. Writes are not affected. Our engineering team is currently working to identify and resolve the root cause. We will provide updates as more information becomes available.

title: Cloudflare Access bypass IP service experiencing availability issues

updates.body: We are investigating an issue affecting the Access IP List service, which may result in failures when bypassing users whose IPs are listed in them. Our engineering team is currently working to identify and resolve the root cause. We will provide updates as more information becomes available.
